purpose: Simplified face reference for Tripo retexturing after reported lipstick-like mouth rim
prompt:
Refine ONLY THE FACE COLOR / TEXTURE DETAILS in this supplied Sprig texture reference to be unambiguously a SIMPLE NON-HUMAN CARTOON PLANT SPRITE. Preserve the whole character design, proportions, large green asymmetrical leaf quiff, T-pose, FOUR digits on each hand, tiny body and feet, colors of skin/leaves, smooth stylized leaf material, camera and white background. One full-body front view, no text or extra views.

The purpose is an image-to-texture reference: another texturing tool is mistakenly drawing human lipstick, eyeliner and black nostrils from the reference. Make the intended simple toy-face paint extremely clear:

MOUTH: a simple small friendly open U-shaped smile. The outer mouth edge and surrounding muzzle remain EXACTLY THE SAME PALE PISTACHIO SKIN COLOR as the rest of the face, continuous skin all the way to the cutout. The opening itself is a dark neutral CHOCOLATE BROWN cavity with a crisp simple silhouette. Zero outer border or separate lip ring, no colored outline around the mouth, no red rim, no vermilion lips, no human lip ridges, no shading resembling a cupid's bow. A tiny subdued PEACH tongue is visible deep INSIDE at the bottom of the cavity; it is clearly separate from the outside skin and well below the upper edge, never touching the mouth corners or wrapping around the rim. Tongue color is soft desaturated peach, not red or hot pink. A very simple cute happy expression, no teeth.

CHEEKS: remove ALL the rosy cheek circles / blush from the supplied reference. Both cheeks have the SAME uniform cream-pistachio skin color as the face and body. No makeup or skin markings. Keep the soft chubby face geometry.

EYES: preserve the approved eye positions, size, warm brown irises and deep pupils, clean cream sclera and ONE small white catchlight. The eye openings transition DIRECTLY to the pistachio skin with no dark eyeliner ring, no upper eyelash strip, no eyelashes or eyeshadow. Brown color is confined to the irises; dark pupil color is confined to the pupils. Do not enlarge the whites or pupils. Eyebrows stay simple green shapes.

NOSE: a tiny softly rounded bump in the same pistachio skin color, no black dot, nostrils, painted nose line or dark spot. Almost no shading on the nose, just a subtle gentle shape.

Materials and lighting: smooth softly matte paint, even neutral diffuse lighting, near-albedo colors with only gentle broad form shading. No strong reflections, dark ambient-occlusion bands around the eyes or mouth, highlight patches, glossy lipstick appearance, dramatic shadows or warm spotlight coloration. Keep the original large simplified green leaf shapes and exact approved hairstyle unchanged. Bright complete front-facing character, white background, ample margins. This is a texture clarification for the SAME existing model, not a redesign.
